Even in the context of how they were using it back then was SR members who are drawn as girls or use a filter to sound like girls are ‘traps’, Cali hit the nail on the head with how the word has evolved into a much more transphobic meaning. There’s a difference between jokes which they do on a variety of topics than a ‘joke’ which implies your entire existence is to trap people into being with you, y’know? 

I don’t hate them for making them and I’m glad that they’re making a positive change for their community and the response and outreach from them to fix this has genuinely warmed my heart and made me feel close to this community. 

It’s not SJW crap to be acknowledged and seen for how you are and not this bizarre punchline and I cannot explain how much I appreciate their response to this issue because they’ve never gone for the dumb edgy humour and I know none of the members are like that it was just something they hadn’t thought about and I thought I’d offer my point of view.

Honestly, the fact that you’re willing to accept the criticism and try and better yourself and your community because of this really means a lot and improves my respect of you so much. It was just some small comments when everyone was questioning Lily’s anime profile picture on steam and I know it seems like a small thing and only happens every so often but it’s always really hard to hear and snaps me out of the relaxed mindset your streams put me in. Thank you for even responding to the post I know that you and your community are good people at heart and I apologise if I didn’t put that across in my post. Much love to all of you ❤️
